key_insight: Accounting for the exact fluid–solid boundary location and correcting mass leakage improves hydrodynamic force accuracy in lattice Boltzmann simulations.
engineering_relevance: More reliable force evaluation supports simulations of complex geometries, moving boundaries, and fluid–structure interactions.
method: Identify force errors caused by the conventional momentum-exchange method’s midpoint-boundary assumption.
Modify momentum exchange to account for the exact boundary position along lattice links.
Correct local mass leakage in interpolation-supplemented bounce-back schemes.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks of increasing complexity show improved force fidelity for flat and curved geometries when modified momentum exchange is combined with mass-corrected bounce-back.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative error reductions or computational overhead, leaving implementation trade-offs to be assessed.
paper_title: Improving the accuracy of the momentum-exchange method in lattice Boltzmann methods
